comment: Source read at commit 95496e8, HEAD of the maker's repository; its plugin.json is byte-for-byte the installed 2.1.0 manifest. Inputs 0, 1, 2 become the high, middle and low bytes of the left word and inputs 3, 4, 5 the same three bytes of the right word (ES5.cpp:45-46), which is why the outputs are described as carrying the first three and the last three. The Category menu (ES5.cpp:98-118) is a submenu named Category holding A, B and C; it selects the divisor at lines 49 to 63 — 0x800000 for A, 0x7fff80 for B and 0x7fffff for C. The maker's page at expert-sleepers.co.uk/vcvrack_encoders.html does not mention it, and the commit that added it is titled only "Added Categories", so no purpose is claimed for it here. The outputs are given no family: they carry encoded words destined for a DAC rather than audio, control voltage, pitch or a trigger. The panel prints the inputs 1 to 6 and leaves the outputs unlabelled; left and right come from the source.
